court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Smt. Indubai Jaydeo Pawar And Anr vs Smt. Draupada @ Draupada Jaydeo Pawar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Indubai Jaydeo Pawar and another (second wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: Draupada @ Draupadi Jaydeo Pawar and others (first wife's children)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Second wife Indubai claimed pension amount of late Jaydeo Pawar after his death. Both wives along with their respective children claimed property.

legal_principles.principle: A child born in a marriage which is null and void under section 11 is legitimate under section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: A child if born in a marriage which is null and void under section 11, is legitimate under section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: An illegitimate child has equal right like his legitimate sibling in the property of his father.
legal_principles.held: However, he has equal right like his legitimate sibling in the property of his father.

outcome.final_order: The petitioner is entitled to succeed to the property of her husband, despite the marriage being void.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: representing a second wife in a property dispute
